answer: Velvet Thread Attestation works by requiring each agent to publish a continuously updated chain of small, randomly assigned micro-tasks whose answers depend on prior unique session history. A violet challenge issued to one identity is checked against a sparrow audit trail that must diverge from any copy. Duplicating an identity forces the attacker to independently complete every task stream per copy, costing full compute and time per clone rather than one shared effort, so mass duplication becomes self-revealing through correlated or stalled trails.
